SYNTHETIC BENCHMARK EVIDENCE - NOT A REAL DOCUMENT - VWPB-R606-7C41-07

RIVERMARK EDUCATION SYSTEMS, INC.
INTERNAL MEMORANDUM - REVENUE ACCOUNTING

Subject:  Standalone selling price (SSP) study - fiscal 2026
Date:     November 30, 2025
Prepared: Revenue accounting; reviewed by Corporate Controller

Summary of concluded standalone selling prices for arrangements executed on
or after December 1, 2025:

1. Rivermark FA Platform annual subscription (up to 25,000 End Users).
   Concluded SSP: $180,000 per subscription year.
   Basis: observable renewal pricing. Renewal transactions in the trailing
   twelve months priced within a narrow band of list; list price is
   $180,000 per year and discounting on renewals is rare.

2. Implementation Services (standard package: configuration, data
   migration, administrator training).
   Concluded SSP: $120,000 (point estimate).
   Observed range: $115,000 to $125,000.
   Basis: standalone sales of the implementation package during the
   trailing twelve months, principally to customers implementing with
   third-party consultants who later purchased the Rivermark package, and
   to customers purchasing re-implementation following platform migrations.

3. Insight Analytics Module.
   Concluded SSP: $4,000 per month.
   Basis: list price; module is sold at list with minimal discounting.

Prices stated in the study are for standalone sales and do not reflect
bundled-arrangement discounting. Where a contractually stated price for a
deliverable differs from concluded SSP, allocation for revenue recognition
purposes should follow the relative SSP method under ASC 606-10-32-31.
